reason: Nb microalloying and precipitate-mediated suppression of lamellar coarsening are more physically plausible in AlCoCrFeNi2.1 than retaining ~2 at.% oxygen as ordered interstitial complexes, which is extrapolated from Ti-rich refractory HEAs and may instead cause oxides, segregation, and embrittlement. B is still weakly grounded and needs defined test conditions plus verification of precipitate identity and passive-film effects, but it offers the more credible falsifiable intervention.
